author: TeIq
content: Origin: #30 audit. polaris-backend/tests/key_rotation.rs needs: (1) AC-15 e2e — emit L1 with K1, rotate, emit L2 with K2, verify both under issuance-time keys (via the verify_label helper that consults signing_key_history). (2) Failure-injection — kill mid-rotation at last_step='key_written', resume from rotation_state, complete cleanly without re-generating the key. (3) Append-only triggers — DELETE / illegal-UPDATE raise P0001, legal active_until-set UPDATE succeeds. testcontainers PG 16-alpine per codebase convention.
